description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R} targeting The Howling Abomination.
Birgi, The Howling Abomination and Runaway Steam-Kin trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Howling Abomination trigger, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Runaway Steam-Kin trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat two additional times.
Activate Runaway Steam-Kin by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
